about_the_game:
Victory Road is a Rogue-Lite, Deck-Builder with a creature collecting twist. Pick a creature, set out on your adventure and try and complete the Victory Road challenge! Choose your path carefully and master the elemental advantage of your creature to gain the upper hand in encounters. Transform your creature to gain even more power and craft the perfect deck of cards to take on any challenge.

Features

  • Creature Transformation: Pick your creature and set out on your adventure! While on the road, your creature will gain experience which will allow it to transform into a wide range of different creatures. Depending on your bond, new forms will be unlocked on your journey!

  • Crafting Decks: Carefully craft a unique deck of elemental based moves that your creature can use in battles. As your creature transforms, new moves will become available through winning battles or purchasing at shops.

  • Rival Companions: While on your journey, you'll encounter a variety of rivals. Winning a battle will have some of them join you at your camp. Speaking with them will raise your bond with them and can lead to them granting you some of their unique cards!
